title: Unsettling
text: “Huh?”
I’ve been told that the Melromarc army is taking advantage of this chaos to launch an invasion. It seems the situation has become quite urgent.
“…At a time like this… what’s the current situation?”
“They’re currently marching toward Siltvelt while declaring war! Their numbers—”

It seems to be quite a large force. Though, if I recall correctly, the Melromarc army used to be even larger. I haven’t counted them exactly, but during the various battles in the first world, their numbers were certainly greater.
“How long will it take them to reach Siltvelt’s main castle?”
“…Considering potential skirmishes along the way, I estimate three days at the earliest.”
“Understood. First, deal with the wave that will strike in a few minutes. Once that’s subdued, begin preparations for war. The problem is…”
The leader of the Shusaku clan seems to understand what Father is getting at.
“Yes. Our nation will not use the Hero for the sake of war.”

This is a concern of my Father’s, and it’s a rule we established together with Éclair and the elder of the Genmu clan. However, that won’t apply if someone appears who intends to harm my Father. I, Motoyasu, will definitely defeat them.
Besides… Melromarc is advancing at this very moment. It’s highly likely this is connected to Takt. No matter what enemy appears, I will fight to avenge everyone’s grievances.
“However…”
“If the other side has dispatched a Hero, that rule doesn’t apply. Right? I understand. I’ll conduct a thorough investigation and report back.”
“…If there’s a violation, I’ll leave the country. My purpose is to fight the Waves to save the world—not for the sake of your so-called war.”
“Understood.”

At first, the leader of the Shusaku clan felt uneasy about Father’s words, but after witnessing my strength firsthand and realizing that there would come a time when even that wouldn’t be enough, he now complies without hesitation.
“Alright then, Motoyasu. Take Yuki and the others with you… and put an end to the Waves right away!”
“Understood!”
“Also, keep tracking down the remnants of the Whip Hero’s faction at the same time… I’ve got a really bad feeling about this.”
“As you command.”
The numbers in my field of vision are approaching zero. We’ve certainly been dragged into quite the incident today.

After the battle with the one who set the trap claiming to be the Whip Hero, the waves… it’s clear they attacked us intentionally. If the battle had dragged on, they probably intended to use the waves to change locations and kill us. I recall that last time, they blocked our escape at the Dragon Sanctuary and the Griffin Sanctuary.
But they’re powerless against me now! I took them out in an instant. This should bring a little peace back to the world.
“Motoyasu, I’m counting on you! I’ll do my best to keep the damage to a minimum.”
“Got it. Hey, it’s still just the early waves. I don’t think it’ll be that dangerous.”
“Just to be safe.”
Just as I’d expect from Father—his cautious, “better safe than sorry” mentality is still going strong. The red hourglass ran out, and I was summoned into the waves of Siltvelt.
“This place is…”

Looking around, it seems to be a mountain in Siltvelt. The boss is a gigantic monster, like Daidarabotchi, casting a black shadow toward us from the mountain. My gut tells me it’s not as strong as it looks. By my estimate, Level 35 should be more than enough. But just as Father said, I’ll be extra careful.
“Yuki-chan and everyone!”
“Got it! Everyone, all-out attack!”

The Filolial-sama and their companions are charging forward. The Siltvelt demi-humans are also rushing headlong toward the monsters pouring out of the waves, each vying to be the first. The monsters this time seem to be Japanese-style creatures—the boss is Daidarabotchi, and there are many others like Nurikabe and Betobeto-san, all bearing black shadows.

There appears to be a village nearby, so Father is prioritizing evacuation by riding Sakura-chan. However, the Demi-Humans of Siltvelt are fierce warriors well-suited for combat; even the villagers seem to be putting up a good fight. Anyway, now it’s time for me to lead the charge.
“Aiming Lancer X!”
I lock onto the monsters in my field of view and unleash my Skills. In an instant, I scatter the monsters and dash toward the wave boss and the crack in the wave.
Well… the result was a landslide victory. Casualties were kept to a minimum. The actual combat time ended before reaching 30 minutes.

But we must not let our guard down. After all, there’s a possibility that some of the Wave monsters survived, one way or another. Plus, we don’t know what might emerge from the Wave Fissure. So, while we remained on high alert, this time it ended without any particular incidents.
“Phew… Well then, the Siltvelt Army, prepare for war! We’re heading back to the castle to attend a meeting!”

The Siltvelt soldiers saluted and set out to prepare for war. There were few injuries, and we managed to keep the damage to a minimum. It’s a conclusion that’s almost too straightforward, but the battle still continues.
“So? What happened to the Melromarc Army?”
“Well… they suddenly retreated and withdrew from the front lines. We’re currently debating whether to pursue them.”
I returned to the castle and attended the meeting with my Father.
“Desertion in the face of the enemy?”
“It’s highly likely that this was a diversionary tactic.”
I see. Indeed, we can’t completely rule out that possibility. Since their numbers were smaller than the total strength of the Melromarc Army, I understand why.
“That ‘Wise King of Wisdom’ has been spotted. We don’t know what he might do!”
The Wise King of Wisdom… Ah, that’s just a nickname for that Trash. But do we really need to be that wary of such an incompetent fool?
“Motoyasu, didn’t the Melromarc ‘Sword Hero’ go to another country?”
“That’s what I’ve heard.”
“Then is Itsuki… the Bow Hero in the Melromarc army?”
“No, a messenger reported that the likelihood of that is low!”
The Shusaku says this with a sigh of relief. Itsuki isn’t participating in the war. It feels a bit off, doesn’t it?
Well, I don’t know Itsuki very well. We hardly ever spoke, either in this world or the previous one. Not that I ever really wanted to know, though.

…I just remembered. If I recall correctly, my Father was furious because I’d unfairly fired a pig… no, a pig with yandere tendencies. It was me—before I’d discovered love—who reported that incident. After that, when I started living in the village, I remember my Father referring to Itsuki as an arrogant, self-righteous fool or something like that.
“Itsuki isn’t participating?”
“Our country’s spies have reported that he’s active within Melromarc!”
“In that case, it seems we definitely won’t need to go into battle.”
“However, I suspect something fishy is going on.”
The leader of the Shusaku clan places pieces arranged in a formation on the map, deep in thought.
“As for the war, what about the damage to the castle?”

“The airship itself caught fire, and the flames spread to the nearby forest, but we were able to extinguish them immediately. However… the enemy’s subordinate who claimed to be the ‘Whip Hero’ fled… and as a result, there have been casualties.”
“I see…”

“There were people firing guns while in a state of confusion, damage to the dragons the Whip Hero had been raising, and so on… I believe we were able to contain the situation to some extent thanks to the Spear Hero…”
“We were saved thanks to Motoyasu, weren’t we?”
“…Yes, sir.”
I’ve made quite a blunder in front of my Father, Motoyasu. I’ll have to do my best not to fail again next time. For now, it’s time to wipe out every last one of those pigs.
“For now, make repairing the castle the top priority and maintain our defensive posture… Prepare to invade Melromarc!”
“I’ve said this many times before, but as long as the Hero isn’t involved, we won’t lend our strength to this war.”
“Understood! Everyone! As the Shield Hero has said, this battle is not about slaying our arch-enemy! Do not forget that!”
“‘Yes, sir!’”
Well then, now is the time to do as much as we possibly can. This is no time to be picky about our methods.
“Father.”
“What is it, Motoyasu?”
“Regarding that dragon’s carcass… I’m actually quite unhappy about this, but if we give its Core Stone to a dragon we’re raising, we’ll be able to perform the ritual to exceed Level 100.”
“Is that so? But I don’t have time to raise one right now… Still, let’s at least collect the Core Stone.”
“Understood.”
